faq.question: Is mirror placement really important in Feng Shui?
faq.answer: Yes. Mirrors reflecting beds or front doors are believed to overstimulate energy and disturb emotional stability.

faq.question: Does clutter block energy flow?
faq.answer: In Feng Shui philosophy, clutter symbolizes stagnation and may represent blocked opportunities or mental stress.

content.text: 1. Bed Directly Aligned with the Door
Known as the 'coffin position,' placing the bed directly in line with the door may create subconscious tension and disturb sleep quality.
Mirrors reflecting the sleeping area can amplify active energy in a space meant for rest, potentially causing restlessness.
The front entrance represents opportunity flow. Shoes, clutter, or dark lighting may symbolically weaken incoming energy.
Sitting with your back to the door may reduce feelings of control and awareness in professional settings.
5. Excessive Clutter and Storage Under the Bed
Items stored under the bed may represent unresolved emotional weight, subtly influencing mood and sleep.
